<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-tools.mjs from the running server. Do not edit by hand. -->

28 tools v0.3.7. 16 read freely. **12 stop at
[the gate](/docs/send-gate)** — every single time, whatever the model decides it wants.

An argument written `like?` is optional.

## Read and search

No gate. These never touch anyone else's phone.

| Tool | What it does | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `doctor` | Runs local diagnostic checks — WhatsApp session state, event-flow liveness (whether events are actually reaching the ingestion pipeline, not just whether the socket is up), message database integrity, injected MCP client configuration, data directory permissions, and whether a newer release is available — and reports one status line per check (ok/warn/fail). | — |
| `download_media` | Downloads media from one chat and saves it under this server's data directory, fetched live. | `chat_jid`, `message_id?`, `message_ids?`, `before?`, `after?`, `date?`, `window?`, `tz?`, `kind?`, `limit?` |
| `fetch_older_messages` | Asks the paired phone to send messages from before the oldest one already stored for a chat, widening how far back that chat can be read and searched. | `chat_jid`, `count?` |
| `get_blocklist` | Lists the JIDs the paired account has blocked, fetched live, one per line. | — |
| `get_call_history` | Lists calls, newest first, optionally filtered to one peer JID and bounded to a time window the server resolves itself — a named `window` (today, yesterday, last_24h, last_7d) or a whole `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) with an IANA `tz`, or explicit before/after bounds (Unix seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD). | `jid?`, `before?`, `after?`, `date?`, `window?`, `tz?`, `limit?` |
| `get_chat` | Looks up a single WhatsApp chat by its JID. | `chat_jid` |
| `get_group_info` | Returns a group's subject, description, owner, and admins, fetched live. | `group_jid` |
| `get_last_interaction` | Returns the most recent message associated with a JID, whether as the chat itself or as a sender within a chat. | `jid` |
| `get_message_context` | Returns the messages immediately surrounding one target message within a chat: up to `before` messages preceding it and up to `after` following it (each 0-100, default 0), oldest to newest. | `chat_jid`, `message_id`, `before?`, `after?` |
| `list_chats` | Lists WhatsApp chats (1:1 and group), newest activity first. | `query?`, `include_archived?`, `limit?` |
| `list_group_participants` | Lists the member JIDs of a WhatsApp group, fetched live. | `group_jid` |
| `list_messages` | Lists messages in one chat, newest first, optionally bounded to a time window the server resolves itself — pass a named `window` (today, yesterday, last_24h, last_7d) or a whole `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) with an IANA `tz`, or explicit before/after bounds (Unix seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD). | `chat_jid`, `before?`, `after?`, `date?`, `window?`, `tz?`, `limit?` |
| `list_scheduled` | Lists pending scheduled sends, soonest first, one per line: id, fire time (RFC 3339 UTC), description. | — |
| `poll_new_messages` | Reports messages that arrived after a cursor, so an agent can react to new activity without re-reading chats. | `cursor?`, `tail?`, `chat_jid?`, `timeout_seconds?`, `include_own?`, `limit?` |
| `search_contacts` | Searches contacts by name or phone number (case-insensitive substring; an empty query matches every contact). | `query?`, `limit?` |
| `search_messages` | Full-text searches message bodies, optionally scoped to one chat. | `query`, `chat_jid?`, `limit?` |

:::caution[How far back these reach is your phone's decision]
Not this server's. See [Limitations](/docs/limitations).
:::

## Send and act

Every one of these is held until you approve it. See
[the send gate](/docs/send-gate) for why that cannot be talked around.

| Tool | What it does | Arguments |
|---|---|---|
| `block_contact` | Blocks a contact. | `jid`, `draft_token?` |
| `cancel_scheduled` | Cancels one pending scheduled send by its id (from schedule_send or list_scheduled). | `id` |
| `create_poll` | Creates a poll in a chat: a question and two or more options. | `to`, `question`, `options`, `selectable_count?`, `draft_token?` |
| `delete_message` | Deletes a message for everyone in the chat (a revoke). | `chat_jid`, `message_id`, `draft_token?` |
| `edit_message` | Edits the text of a message you already sent, replacing its body. | `chat_jid`, `message_id`, `text`, `draft_token?` |
| `mark_read` | Marks one or more messages in a chat as read. | `chat_jid`, `message_ids` |
| `schedule_send` | Schedules a message (or media file) to send at a future time, up to 30 days ahead. | `to`, `text?`, `path?`, `send_at?`, `delay_minutes?`, `draft_token?` |
| `send_media` | Sends an image, video, or document file from local disk, with an optional caption. | `to`, `path`, `caption?`, `draft_token?` |
| `send_message` | Sends a WhatsApp text message, optionally quoting an existing message. | `to`, `text`, `quote_message_id?`, `draft_token?` |
| `send_reaction` | Reacts to an existing message with an emoji (an empty emoji removes a previously sent reaction). | `chat_jid`, `message_id`, `emoji`, `draft_token?` |
| `send_voice_note` | Sends a voice note (push-to-talk audio) from a local Ogg Opus (.ogg) file; this version does no transcoding, so any other format is rejected. | `to`, `path`, `draft_token?` |
| `unblock_contact` | Unblocks a contact. | `jid`, `draft_token?` |
